newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AssiDoman in 200 mln skr Czech plant deal.
newsitem.headline: AssiDoman in 200 mln skr Czech plant deal.

text.p: Swedish forestry products group AssiDoman AB said on Wednesday it would invest 200 million Swedish crowns in a new corrugated board plant in the Czech republic southwest of Prague.
Production is planned to start during the summer of 1998, the company said in a statement.
Annual corrugated board capacity will amount to about 70 million cubic meters and the number of employees is estimated to be around 100 in the initial phase, the company said.

"To become established in the Czech republic is a natural consequence of our interest in central and eastern Europe," said AssiDoman's president and chief executive officer Lennart Ahlgren in a statement.
The Czech republic has strong economic growth and the market growth for corrugated board is strong, the company said.
Furthermore, the Czech republic's central location in Europe, bordering on Germany, Poland, Austria and Slovakia, mean a presence is very significant, the company said.
